precepts.text: As a woman in the ninth month brings forth within two or three hours with pains that slack not, so shall the plagues not be slack to come upon the earth. In the time of nations, hours are years and months.
precepts.point: Contractions come and ease and come again closer together. A pain comes one month, things calm, another comes two or three months later. When it calms, Israelites say nothing is going to happen and go back to business as usual. The real brothers and sisters do not need warning.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
Paul says, “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Peace and safety is what Trump keeps saying, the peace president who bombed Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. Some of you love it when the president talks about peace, stomping your feet because you think nothing is going to happen in this country. Ezra shows what travail upon a woman with child means.

“As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment.” Within two or three hours: in the time of nations that is two or three years, or months. When a woman is having a baby, her contractions come ten minutes apart, then five, six, five, four, closer and closer.

“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” A pain comes one month, then things calm down; another comes two or three months later, and things calm down again. That is how it is going to be in this world.

But when things calm down, Israelites say nothing is going to happen and go back to business as usual. That is why Paul says “of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.” We read the prophecies every week, and if you are not paying attention you will be caught off guard. The real brothers and the real sisters will not need to be warned; they are aware of what is about to happen.

precepts.text: When they shall say peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child, and they shall not escape. When they think they have subdued the earth, it comes; birthing pains, one thing today, another in two or three months or years.
precepts.point: When thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled, and when thou makest an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. God will let the nations rise up.

note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
The New Testament speaks of the same thing. “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them”. They are going to think it's all good: we have subdued the earth, everything is ours. And the Lord says no; when you say that, then comes sudden destruction.

“as travail upon a woman with child” means birthing pains. One thing may happen today, it may calm down, and two to three months later something else happens, or it might be two to three years later. It comes like a woman giving birth. “and they shall not escape.”

That is the end of Isaiah 33:1: “when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.” When America stops robbing countries, it is going to be robbed; the nations shall deal treacherously with it, and it will come right when it says peace and safety.

precepts.why:
“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many”. His policy is his politics. And Trump now has what is called the Board of Peace, and it charges nations a billion dollars for a permanent seat. It was first pitched to oversee the rebuilding of Gaza after the Israel and Hamas war; now its charter reaches to conflicts the world over and does not even mention Gaza, and it is set up as an alternative to the United Nations. Now you know why he didn't stop Netanyahu from bombing them.

Its founding members include Jared Kushner, Amalek, and Marco Rubio, supporting Amalek, and Tony Blair. When Amalek was killing the Palestinians in Gaza, there was a lot of complaint against them in the UN. With this, when they start killing people and taking land, you have nowhere to run to complain, because they run it. Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the African countries that sit on it will have no power. And the UN itself only has power over dark nations; Europe doesn't listen to it, and its building sits on stolen land while the Native American Indians have no seat in it at all.

Trump is not the one doing this; he is a figurehead to divert your attention. The shadow government, the powers behind him, are running it. If Trump weren't there, it would still be going on.

Paul says, “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Peace and safety is that Board of Peace. By peace he shall destroy many, but “he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”, that is Christ, “but he shall be broken without hand.” It is the same stone of Daniel 2: this last empire, the extension of ancient Rome, is going to fall. The great stone shall smash the heel, for Esau is the end of the world.

precepts.text: Ye are all the children of light and the children of the day.
precepts.point: Satan and evil were created too, and everything is made in pairs.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
“Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day”. This shows when the children of light were created. In Genesis 1 it was not only the light that was created; the light's children were created too. Christ said that he and the children are one. We were already in Christ, and when that light was formed we were in it. Then the Father chose: those on the right side are his children, and those on the left side, the two-thirds and those heathens over there, are the darkness.

God called the light Day, so we are the children of the day. That is why Day and Night are capitalized in the King James: a specific day and a specific night, good and evil, right angels and wrong ones, right spirits and wrong spirits. The apostles understood these things, and the translators did too. The spirit was on them as well when they put it in English; that council was divinely inspired. It wasn't regular men. Some of y'all dumb negroes don't speak a word of Hebrew and are trying to insult them; you're not on their level at all whatsoever. “we are not of the night, nor of darkness.” Day and night compare good and evil and the children of each, and all of that took place on the first day.

Paul goes on: “Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober. For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation. For God hath not appointed us to wrath”. We should not be sleeping; we have to be aware of the time we are living in. God did not appoint us to wrath because we are the children of the day, the children of the light.

Who is the day? 2 Peter 1:19: “a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. We are that light shining in a dark place, and the day star arising in our hearts is Christ. He is the day.

2 Esdras 9 shows the children of light before the earth: “And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. For then every one obeyed”. We were there with the Lord in the beginning in our angelic, celestial bodies, the body we will have when Christ returns, and we all obeyed. “but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed”. Covered in this flesh, we became rebellious. Knowing who we were is meant to give us the faith and hope to endure in this truth.

precepts.text: Prove all things; if you cannot prove it, do not utter it.
precepts.point: From the beginning the Most High commanded the prophets to speak his words and diminish not a word: do not be afraid to tell the nations what the scripture actually says, that salvation is to Israel and that there is no female deity.

note.label: Deuteronomy 4: Neither Add nor Diminish

precepts.why:
“Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.” If you cannot prove it, do not utter it.

An opinion off the top of your head cannot be proven by scripture, and adding it to the word is what Moses forbids. Do not quote what the Most High has not said; prove it from the scripture, and hold fast that which is good.

precepts.text: Comfort and edify one another, know them which labor among you and are over you in the Most High, and esteem them highly in love.
precepts.point: It is good for us to dwell among ourselves because that is all we have; everybody else hates our guts, a thing we understand as we grow in the truth. We admonish, edify, comfort, and esteem one another in the scriptures.

note.label: Psalm 133: The Brethren Dwelling Together in Unity

precepts.why:
Dwelling together in unity looks like this: “comfort yourselves together, and edify one another”, “know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.” Then “warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.”

We admonish, edify, comfort, and esteem one another in the scriptures. That is how good and how pleasant it is for the brethren, the twelve tribes, to dwell together, because everybody else hates our guts and we are all we have.
